questions.explanationEn: A proper fraction has numerator less than denominator, so the proper fractions are \(\frac{3}{5}\) and \(\frac{11}{12}\). An improper fraction has numerator greater than or equal to denominator, so the improper fractions are \(\frac{7}{4}\) and \(\frac{9}{9}\). The remaining numbers, \(2\frac{1}{3}\) and \(5\frac{2}{7}\), are mixed numbers.

questions.promptZh: 對每個數判斷它能否依次被 2、5、10 整除：(a) 75；(b) 130；(c) 502；(d) 1200；(e) 1005；(f) 4020。請在同一答案中按「(a) 否、是、否；…；(f) …」格式作答；可用 ✓ 表示「是」、✗ 表示「否」。每組順序均為 2、5、10。
questions.promptEn: For each number, state in order whether it is divisible by 2, 5, and 10: (a) 75; (b) 130; (c) 502; (d) 1200; (e) 1005; (f) 4020. Give all six parts in one response in the format “(a) No, Yes, No; …; (f) …”. You may use ✓ for Yes and ✗ for No. Each three-entry group must follow the order 2, 5, 10.
acceptedAnswers: (a) No, Yes, No; (b) Yes, Yes, Yes; (c) Yes, No, No; (d) Yes, Yes, Yes; (e) No, Yes, No; (f) Yes, Yes, Yes
(a) 否, 是, 否; (b) 是, 是, 是; (c) 是, 否, 否; (d) 是, 是, 是; (e) 否, 是, 否; (f) 是, 是, 是
questions.explanationZh: 能被 2 整除要看末位是否為偶數；能被 5 整除要看末位是否為 0 或 5；能被 10 整除要看末位是否為 0。依此可得：(a) ✗, ✓, ✗；(b) ✓, ✓, ✓；(c) ✓, ✗, ✗；(d) ✓, ✓, ✓；(e) ✗, ✓, ✗；(f) ✓, ✓, ✓。
questions.explanationEn: A number is divisible by 2 if its last digit is even, by 5 if its last digit is 0 or 5, and by 10 if its last digit is 0. Applying these rules gives (a) No, Yes, No; (b) Yes, Yes, Yes; (c) Yes, No, No; (d) Yes, Yes, Yes; (e) No, Yes, No; and (f) Yes, Yes, Yes.
